info.longName: Pacer Lunt Large Cap Alternator ETF

funds_data.description: The index uses an objective, rules-based methodology to provide exposure to large-capitalization U.S. companies. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of large cap companies. It is non-diversified.
